sql.select: SELECT TK_T.TK_NO , CONVERT(int, TK_T.PTN_CD) AS PTN_CD , M.HON_BIKO , M.HON_TAIKAI_CD , M.HAI_BIKO , M.HAI_TAIKAI_CD , M.BIKO , TK_T.HON_YOTAKUKIN_KINGAKU , TK_T.HAI_YOTAKUKIN_KINGAKU , TK_T.HON_TYOIKIN_KINGAKU , TK_T.HAI_TYOIKIN_KINGAKU FROM TK_T_YOTEKUKIN_YOTEI TK_T LEFT OUTER JOIN TK_M_YOTEKUKIN_YOTEI M ON TK_T.PTN_CD = M.PTN_CD WHERE TK_T.TK_NO = ? AND M.HON_TAIKAI_CD IN (?, 'XX') AND M.HAI_TAIKAI_CD IN (?, 'XX')
UPDATE TK_YOTAKU SET HON_SHIHARAI_YOTAKUKIN = ? , HON_SHIHARAI_TYOIKIN = ? , HAI_SHIHARAI_YOTAKUKIN = ? , HAI_SHIHARAI_TYOIKIN = ? WHERE TK_NO = ?
